name: "Cacio e Pepe" Grilled Cheese with Prosciutto & Creamy Asparagus Soup

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium carrots
6 sticks celery
1 ½ small bunches asparagus

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and medium dice carrots. Place in a large bowl.
Trim and medium dice celery. Add to the bowl with the carrot.
Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut into 1-inch pieces. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and medium dice onions. Add to the bowl.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are softened, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp butter, unsalted
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Set aside.
When the veggies are softened, add flour to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until veggies are well coated, 1-2 minutes.

Add broth and milk to the pot; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until soup thickens slightly, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
instructions.secondary_message:
1420 ml chicken or vegetable broth
355 ml whole milk

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place half of the bread slices on a flat surface. Top with Parmesan, season with pepper, then layer with prosciutto. Cover sandwiches with the remaining bread slices.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 slices whole grain bread
1 ½ tsp black pepper
12 slices prosciutto

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, place sandwiches in the skillet and cook until the bottoms are golden brown, 2-4 minutes.

Remove the sandwiches to a plate and add more butter to the skillet. Return sandwiches to the skillet, browned-side up, and cook until golden brown on the other side and the cheese is melted, 2-4 minutes more. Once done, transfer to a cutting board and slice in half.
Divide soup between bowls and serve with sandwiches on the side. Enjoy!
